verdict.rationale: xAI publishes a full public REST API with documented endpoints for text, image, video, tool use, structured outputs, and an OpenAPI spec confirmed live by probe, plus a quickstart guide, satisfying the AI-native/agentic driving story. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of API reliability/completeness beyond xAI's own docs and anecdotal community chatter about tool-calling quirks.
